---
title: Delete Vendor
description: Soft-delete a vendor metadata entry by ID.
api: "DELETE /api/vendors/{id}"
---

Deletes the vendor metadata entry with the given ID. The deletion is a soft delete: the record is marked as deleted and excluded from vendor lists, and its name becomes available for reuse.

Requires **Admin** permissions. See [Authentication](/nookmux/api/management/auth) for how to authenticate management API requests.

## Request

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request DELETE \
  --url 'https://your-nookmux-domain/api/vendors/1' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'New-Api-User: 1'
```

</RequestExample>

### Path parameters

<ParamField path="id" type="integer" required>
  Vendor ID.
</ParamField>

## Response

<ResponseExample>

```json 200
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": null
}
```

</ResponseExample>

### Response fields

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean" required>
  Whether the vendor was deleted.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string" required>
  Error description when `success` is `false`; empty otherwise.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="null">
  Always `null` on success.
</ResponseField>

<Note>
Management endpoints return HTTP `200` even on business failures; always check the `success` field. Successful deletions are recorded in the admin audit log (vendor module).
</Note>

## Error messages

| Condition | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Invalid parameters | `id` is not a valid integer |
| Database error, please try again later | Deleting the vendor failed; see server logs |
